_comment: SJVN Khavda 200 MW - project configuration. Read by the data builder (dash_data.py: calendar, vocabulary, paths) and published to the page as DATA.cfg (labels, procurement columns). Never put API tokens here - they live in the gitignored scripts/vl_tokens.json / Actions secrets.
title: SJVN Khavda 200 MW — MIS Dashboard (Live)
name: SJVN Khavda 200 MW

calendar._comment: day 1 of the working-day axis = earliest planned start in VisiLean. 6-day week, Sunday off - confirmed by KP (04-Sep-2026); VisiLean dates that fall on a Sunday are placed on the working-day axis the same way as for NTPC

_baselineMode_comment: Neither VisiLean nor the MSP carries baseline dates for this project (checked 04-Sep-2026). 'planned' = VisiLean planned dates ARE the baseline and rows are not flagged un-baselined. Switch to 'visilean' once the team sets a baseline in VisiLean.
_activityTypeFromDepartment_comment: no 'Activity Type' custom field in this project; Engineering / Procurement - Supply / Procurement - Services / Construction are derived from the department so the EPC bifurcation and S-curve disciplines work
_area_comment: areas are the four 50 MW feeders. VisiLean 'location' is blank on 63% of rows, so the feeder number is read from WBS Level 3 ('Feeder-2 - 50 MW'), Level 4 ('Feeder-4 (L&G)') or the location ('Feeder 2 - ...')
_packageFromField_comment: in this project the 'Package' custom field holds the Level-2 group (Supply / Construction / Design Approval), not a package, so packages come from the WBS levels: Level 3 for supply ('Inverter (SPLY)'), the deepest work package for execution
_itemJoinLevel4_comment: procurement runs per feeder under each package, so the pipeline row is package x feeder

departments._comment: VisiLean 'Department' custom field -> dashboard department key; 'Dept/Level2-prefix' splits a department on Level 2

supplySummary._comment: the package summary row ('PV Module (SPLY)') carries no Level 3/4 - the feeder sub-summaries and leaves beneath it do - and is named after the package; its planned end is the package delivery date

procurementSteps._comment: 'Type of Work' values, in pipeline order; keys are the normalised task names
